overview: The Rome Police Department uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. The department utilizes retroactive searches to solve crimes after they have occurred. Additionally, the Rome Police Department utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
